title: 2009 OES-based AEWR switch and 2010 return to FLS: within-state OES-area effective-floor dose, employer-location county x receipt FY, FY2006-FY2011
proposer: catalogue (plan A2); kept at triage by the credibility pass only (merge)
implementer: Claude Opus 5.5 (Phase 2 acquisition and Phase 3 A2 designer)
kill_reason: Design-stage size-valid MDE exceeds 1.0 under every pass-through assumption: 2.78 in epsilon_cost at pi = 1 (gate DGP county_serial, state jackknife; the only size-valid method), 6.95 at the declared pi_design = 0.4 (4.63 at pi = 0.6, 9.27 at pi = 0.3). Under the shared DGPs no method in the primary frame passes the size gate. The within-state OES dose is small after truncation and regime timing: SD $0.14 after FE, 13.3 effective states. Not pooling-eligible. No outcome contrast was computed.
estimand: PPML semi-elasticity of county (employer-location) certified H-2A contract hours per dollar of the effective statutory floor, identified within state from the OES-area floor of the 2009-10 regime (county FE + state x FY FE); epsilon_cost = (eta / pi_hat) x C_bar.
primary_outcome: cert_hours_c: county x receipt-FY certified positions x weeks x 40 (constant weekly hours because weekly hours are missing in FY2008-10), employer-location rows, non-monthly pay, FY2006-FY2011; PPML
dose: x_ct = sum_d omega_d x floor_c(d). Floor = max(FLS AEWR_s, state ag minimum wage) in FLS periods; max(OWL 45-2092 Level I of c's OES area, 7.25, state ag minimum wage) for receipts 2009-01-17 to 2010-03-14 (wage year 7/2008-6/2009 to 2009-06-30, 7/2009-6/2010 after). omega = national FY2006-08 receipt-month hours shares, so the OES regime share is 0.713 in FY2009 and 0.596 in FY2010. $/hour. Blank 45-2092 L1 cells: counties excluded (74); fill chain as sensitivity.
identifying_assumption: Within a state, counties in OES areas with higher 2009-10 Level I floors would have had the same proportional growth in certified hours FY2006-FY2011 as counties in lower-floor areas, conditional on 2006-07 construction and manufacturing shares x FY.

conversion.formula: epsilon_cost = (eta / pi_hat) x C_bar; C_bar = ratio_A2 x w_bar = 1.2455 x 8.7083 = 10.846; ITT eta x C_bar; epsilon_w = epsilon_cost / ratio_A2

cost_ratio_used.rule: FY2006-11 mean of cost_unit_by_fy.csv ratios; FY2006-07 = FY2008, FY2009 = mean(FY2008, FY2010)

conversion.assumptions: dC = d(floor); offered wage = H-2A wage; floor priced at filing; expected-temporary contested cut (short-run estimand). pi not estimated (killed before estimation); pi_design 0.4 from the share of 2009 hourly cases at an OWL Level I rate (41.6% / 37.5%) and the prior proxy slope 0.29.

support.basis: 1,393 employer-location counties x 6 receipt FY (FY2006-11), 432 OES areas (effective areas 34.0, max area leverage 0.091), 49 states; PPML weights = FY2006-08 mean county hours; residual SD of the PPML-linearized FY2006-08 outcome after county + state x FY FE (weighted).
support.truncation: Hours-weighted within-state SD of the area floor: 2008-09 $0.59 raw -> $0.45 truncated (58.5% of variance survives; 64% of pre-period hours in truncated counties); 2009-10 $0.54 -> $0.48 (77%; 42%). FY dose SD after FE: 0.141 truncated vs 0.170 untruncated counterfactual.
support.other_candidates: no controls 0.142 / 13.0 eff. states; blank-filled 0.140 / 13.4; state x nonmetro x FY FE 0.128 / 11.6; equal weights 0.173 / 23.3; OES-area unit 0.141 / 13.6; worksite-county FY2008-11 (shared panel) 0.149 / 16.6 (one pre-year; no calibration possible). File $S/A2/a2_support.csv.

design_mde_by_dgp.note: epsilon_cost at pi_design = 0.4 (pi = 1: county_serial 2.78, state CV3J). Shared DGPs: no method passes the size gate in the primary frame (state CRV1 null 0.091, jackknife 0.073, area CRV1 0.121; non-size-valid MDEs at pi = 1 are 3.1-4.4). Alternates at pi = 1: no controls 2.83 county_serial (state CV3J), 3.62 shared (area RI within state); OES-area unit no size-valid method (best 2.8-3.4); blank-filled 3.74 shared (state CV3J), county_serial no size-valid method. Files $S/A2/a2_power_*.csv.

gate_dgp: county_serial: ish_node_period_share on the PPML-linearized FY2006-08 hours with node = OES area x state gives 0.434 vs 0.322 pure unit noise (ratio 1.35 <= 1.5)
inference_primary: state_fips_CV3J (the state CRV1 null is 0.073, upper 0.091, so it fails the size gate under county_serial)
split_detail: No data-driven tuning: every choice was fixed in the registry. 49 states and 432 areas would permit a split.
prior_exposure: wage_reversal_2009_2010_exploration.md sections 2-4: filing spikes and below-FLS shares; proxy-floor offered-wage slope 0.29; county PPML of certified workers and applications on proxy exposure x FY2009-13 with region x FY FE, which rose through 2013 (read as a trend). outputs/reports/wage_reforms.md section 1: local wage discontinuities and weekly counts; cohort_responses.csv early cohort FY2009-12. Power triage: FY2011-14 residual variance. Acquisition: case-level OWL rate matches by regime. Phase 0: national totals. This designer read outcomes only for FY2006-08 (residual variance, weights, receipt-month shares) and the FY2008 employer-vs-worksite geography agreement (88% of position-weeks).
falsification_result: not_run (killed at design); declared F1 pre-trend leads, F2 placebo date, F3 return symmetry, F4 balance, F5 first-stage placebo
external_validity_flag: true: an expected-temporary, legally contested 2009 cut (short-run response); 45-2092 Level I intent-to-treat floor
notes: Scripts A2/03_rows_panel.R, 04_dose.R, 05_controls.R, 06_support.R, 07_power.R; outputs and logs in $S/A2/. The acquired 2009 schedules, crosswalk and FY2006-07 disclosures remain usable by F1/F2 (A2 as an F2 holdout event) and by any A6 stacking that reads registries; A2 enters no pooled estimate.
